title: Automated intake clarifier: structured questionnaire to convert freeform enterprise feature requests into eval-ready artifacts
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit verbose, freeform feature requests for hosted API capabilities (chat streaming, function/tool calling, structured outputs). PMs spend significant time clarifying scope, expected outputs, and compliance constraints before prioritization. This slows onboarding, inflates time-to-decision, and creates inconsistent evaluation artifacts (missing prompt examples, unclear success criteria, no safety/risk notes).

Objective: Ship an 'Intake Clarifier' — a guided, automated questionnaire that transforms a freeform enterprise feature request into a standardized evaluation bundle (short problem statement, acceptance criteria, representative prompt(s)/input(s), expected output schema, latency/cost SLOs, data residency / compliance constraints, and preliminary risk classification). The tool should be embedded in the enterprise intake flow and surface triage recommendations (priority bucket, necessary engineering review, suggested quantization/model profile) to speed decisioning by 40% and reduce follow-up clarification threads by 60%.

Scope: Hosted API enterprise intake only (not Dedicated/Private for this phase). Questionnaire covers chat streaming, multi-action toolchains, structured outputs (JSON schemas/embeddings), and function calling. Backend produces an attachable artifact in the Linear ticket and an eval-ready snippet that Research/QA can run.

Success metrics (first 90 days):
- Median time from request creation to triage decision <= 48 hours (baseline ~5 business days).
- Follow-up clarifying questions per ticket reduced by >= 60%.
- Intake artifacts include: 1 problem statement, 2 example prompts, 1 expected output schema OR golden example, priority suggestion, and risk tags in >= 85% of processed enterprise requests.

Design constraints & trade-offs:
- Trade-off: questionnaire length vs. clarity. Aim for 6-9 smart questions (progressive disclosure) to minimize customer friction while collecting required signals.
- Trade-off: automation vs. manual override. Provide editable artifact for PM/SE to refine prior to final triage.
- Privacy: do not persist unredacted PII in shared artifacts; redact or mark sensitive fields per compliance settings.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal alpha: wire questionnaire into PM intake UI (internal only) with a synthetic set of enterprise examples. Duration: 2 sprints.
2) Beta: opt-in enterprise customers and Solutions Engineers; collect labeling for risk classifier and priority suggestions. Duration: 4 weeks.
3) GA: enable by default for enterprise tenant onboarding flows, with audit logs and opt-out.

Acceptance criteria:
- Questionnaire UI implemented and hooked to intake flow.
- Backend transforms answers into a standardized JSON-LD artifact (human editable) and attaches it to the Linear ticket.
- Priority suggestion and preliminary risk classification appear in the ticket.
- At least 10 pilot customers processed with artifacts meeting the artifact completeness target (see success metrics).

Risks & mitigations: 
- Risk: Classifier suggests wrong priority causing misallocation. Mitigation: default to 'Requires PM review' on low-confidence predictions and expose model confidence.
- Risk: Customers find questionnaire burdensome. Mitigation: progressive disclosure and a one-click 'skip and schedule clarifying call' fallback.
- Risk: Sensitive customer data captured. Mitigation: validation on input fields, PII redaction pipeline, and tenant data retention settings tied to compliance labels.

Open questions: 
- Which internal owner will manage the templating rules for different feature domains (chat vs tools vs structured)? Proposal: Solutions Engineering owns templates with PM oversight.
- Do we ship the initial risk taxonomy as 'none/low/medium/high' or include granular risk tags (data residency, exec-affecting, legal-contractual)? Proposal: start with coarse labels plus checkbox list for granular tags.

Next steps (this ticket):
- Finalize questionnaire Q/A draft with Solutions Eng and Legal (owner: Ethan Morales) by 2026-03-18.
- Prototype wireframe and validation flow with Design (owner: Kara Liu) by 2026-03-22.
- Backend spec for artifact generation and storage (owner: ENG, lead: Priya Shen) by 2026-03-25.
